svg.title: Preprocessing must respect the data split

g.text: Split independent originals before fitting transformations or splitting augmented copies.
LEAKED: fit scaler / target encoder on ALL data → split → evaluate
Validation features—or even labels—have already influenced the representation.
SPLIT FIRST: independent training originals | validation originals
TRAIN: learn transformation within training folds; augment training originals
VALIDATE: apply fitted transformation; no augmented siblings from training
Target encoding: protect outer validation AND training rows' own labels.
Conceptual diagram • a high validation score alone cannot diagnose leakage.
